cohort: The study included 347 mothers from a university hospital.
finding: There was a statistically significant negative relationship between postpartum sleep quality and both the perception of insufficient milk and attitude to breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Mode of birth (general anesthesia and cesarean) showed a statistically significant correlation with the Perception of Insufficient Milk score.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in the early postpartum period between December 2021 and July 2022.
